Typed the printed text of every in-scope field into a script (lead-in bullets as "\n• ", " • " between composing/elective bullet lines, a space for unbulleted lines, "\n" between the two Q6 Excerpt 3(i) lines either side of the printed options, tick boxes as "□ ", the Q5 B stem per the lane ruling) and compared each file string exactly with no normalisation; then checked every typed word token exactly (case, punctuation, apostrophe and dash code points) against the text-layer spans of the ask's pages; then listed the code point of every non-ASCII character in the file strings (¹ U+00B9, é U+00E9, í U+00ED, – U+2013, ’ U+2019, “ U+201C, ” U+201D, • U+2022, □ U+25A1, ♭ U+266D). The file has no readFromPage entries. Elective Q2-Q4(b) carry no grid, so no grid.stem there. Every address matches the printed numbering (Q5 A Excerpt 2's (i)-(iii) are printed once for both dances; elective "4.(a)" / "(b)" read as Q4(a) / Q4(b)).
